caption: The drawing features four horizontal bands, each with distinct geometric and decorative patterns. The top band consists of alternating red squares and yellow diamonds with blue dots and yellow "X" shapes within the diamonds, bordered by a black outline. The second band from the top has a background of yellow and green with red accents, and is decorated with swirling blue and green lines, plus triangular red patterns at the corners. The third band is divided vertically into three sections; the left and right sections are teal green with black and white lines, while the central section has a pattern that includes a fan-shaped motif in red, blue, white, and black, with small black dots and accents. The bottom band is a patchwork of various sections: starting from the left with gold-yellow, black, and red triangular elements, followed by alternating sections of yellow with black line detail, solid red, black-outlined white with curved black borders, more red, and ending with a green section on the right, all bordered with a black outline. All bands are placed parallel to each other on a plain beige background. The number “49” appears in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Plate 49: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
